items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Plans Tokenized Stock Venue With 113 Assets
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) plans to launch a tokenized stock venue offering 113 assets, expanding its digital securities footprint. The new platform brings tokenized versions of traditional equities onto blockchain rails, aimed at institutional and potentially retail participants. This move extends ICE's existing work in digital asset infrastructure into tokenized stocks, alongside its data and technology services business.
